The depot was **Southgate**. I've posted this in a thread on your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

It comes from this channel. On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch stacking totes beside door 4. Her note at 18:43 that day says labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or site ID for Southgate. It isn't in this channel or #central-team, and none of the shared files you can see cover Tansley Parcel. If the customer call needs the full site details, Priyanka or Hollis would be the ones to ask.
